<thought>All measurements show that each intermediate node lies on its own series branch between A and B, because the resistance from A to the node plus from the node to B always equals the total A‑B resistance (125 Ω). Hence the circuit is a set of ten parallel branches, each branch consisting of two resistors in series. The resistor values are taken directly from the measured half‑branch resistances, and the connections are listed accordingly. The required output is a JSON string describing this topology.</thought>
<final_answer>"{\"resistors\": {\"R1\": 6.667, \"R2\": 118.333, \"R3\": 25.0, \"R4\": 100.0, \"R5\": 75.0, \"R6\": 50.0, \"R7\": 11.667, \"R8\": 113.333, \"R9\": 30.0, \"R10\": 95.0, \"R11\": 40.0, \"R12\": 85.0, \"R13\": 55.0, \"R14\": 70.0, \"R15\": 80.0, \"R16\": 45.0, \"R17\": 90.0, \"R18\": 35.0, \"R19\": 105.0, \"R20\": 20.0}, \"connections\": [[\"A\",\"X1\",\"R1\"],[\"X1\",\"B\",\"R2\"],[\"A\",\"X2\",\"R3\"],[\"X2\",\"B\",\"R4\"],[\"A\",\"X3\",\"R5\"],[\"X3\",\"B\",\"R6\"],[\"A\",\"N_b1\",\"R7\"],[\"N_b1\",\"B\",\"R8\"],[\"A\",\"N_c1\",\"R9\"],[\"N_c1\",\"B\",\"R10\"],[\"A\",\"N_c2\",\"R11\"],[\"N_c2\",\"B\",\"R12\"],[\"A\",\"N_c3\",\"R13\"],[\"N_c3\",\"B\",\"R14\"],[\"A\",\"N_d1\",\"R15\"],[\"N_d1\",\"B\",\"R16\"],[\"A\",\"N_d2\",\"R17\"],[\"N_d2\",\"B\",\"R18\"],[\"A\",\"N_d3\",\"R19\"],[\"N_d3\",\"B\",\"R20\"]]}"</final_answer>
